scientific_integrity: Pure centered-quadratic rank-one fourth-moment extremality is previously established; only the mixed OU restricted operator curve, threshold, equality cases and exact deficit are assessed as new. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real centered Gaussian polynomials of degree at most two; finite dimension; fourth output moment. Other exponents, constants, complex coefficients and higher degrees are not claimed.
title: Exact restricted Gaussian hypercontractivity across the first two Wiener chaoses
